items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items.title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.2 与 Claude Mythos 5.2
items.title_en: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
items.summary: Anthropic announces Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, prompting active Hacker News discussion about model quality, benchmark methodology, release strategy, and pricing.

items.title: E-means: Outperforming k-means in one-tenth the epochs
items.title_zh: E-means：用十分之一的迭代轮次达到 k-means 聚类质量的质心更新规则
items.title_en: E-means: a centroid update rule that reaches k-means quality in one-tenth the epochs
items.summary: E-means presents a centroid-update rule that keeps centroids within the convex hull and converges to k-means-quality clusters in roughly one-tenth the epochs, with Hacker News commenters reporting both strong speedups in vector-index workloads and cases where it does not help.

items.title: Google Gemini routes personal Drive files and emails to human annotators
items.title_zh: 消费者版 Gemini 可将个人 Drive 文件和 Gmail 内容转交人工审核
items.title_en: Consumer Gemini can route personal Drive files and Gmail to human reviewers
items.summary: A report showing that consumer Google Gemini with Connected Apps can send personal Drive files and Gmail content to human reviewers, with commenters highlighting the consumer/Workspace privacy-policy distinction and broader data-use concerns.

items.title: GitHub 新架构支持每秒 7200 次推送  GitHub 推出代号 Rubicon 的新 Git 存储架构，面向大量 AI 智能体并发操作单个仓库的场景。
items.title_zh: GitHub 推出 Rubicon 存储架构，面向 AI 智能体实现每秒 7200 次推送
items.title_en: GitHub's Rubicon storage architecture targets 7,200 pushes per second for AI agents
items.summary: GitHub introduced a new Git storage architecture codenamed Rubicon, designed to support thousands of concurrent AI agents and up to 7,200 pushes per second using Azure Blob Storage and Ref-CAS.

items.title: 🐶 Google 开源 TorchTPU，挑战 NVIDIA AI 生态主导地位  Google Cloud 宣布与 Meta 的 PyTorch 团队共同开发
items.title_zh: Google 开源 TorchTPU，让 TPU 成为 PyTorch 原生后端
items.title_en: Google Open-Sources TorchTPU, Making TPUs a Native PyTorch Backend
items.summary: Google Cloud and Meta's PyTorch team have open-sourced TorchTPU on GitHub, making TPUs a native PyTorch backend with near-zero code changes and support from vLLM, SGLang, and Hugging Face Transformers v5, directly challenging NVIDIA's AI ecosystem dominance.
